fields.name: invalidated_at
fields.doc: Time the view was invalidated.

fields.name: view_revision
fields.doc:
Revision that GetAddressBookView must reach before the invalidation is
 considered satisfied.

types.name: auth.v1.ApiKey
types.doc: ApiKey is public API key metadata. It never includes the private key or seed.

fields.name: key_id
fields.doc:
Stable opaque identifier used to refer to this key, formatted as "ak_"
 followed by 32 lowercase hex characters.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: Human-readable label for the key. Maximum length is 64 characters.

fields.name: icon
fields.doc: Optional user-chosen icon/emoji for UI display.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Optional user-chosen color token for UI display.

fields.name: ip_whitelist
fields.doc:
Optional CIDR whitelist. Empty means no IP restriction. Maximum 32 unique
 entries.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Current key status.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Optional sub-account this key is scoped to (opaque ID; empty = root-level).

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: policy_id
fields.doc:
Optional API policy attached to this key (opaque ID).
 Empty means no policy is attached and the key has no permissions.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: Time in UTC when this key was created.

fields.name: last_used_at
fields.doc:
Approximate last time in UTC when this key authenticated a request,
 recorded at most about once a minute; it may lag recent use by a few
 minutes. Omitted when no use has been recorded.

fields.name: public_key_ed25519
fields.doc:
Ed25519 public key bytes associated with this API key. The private key or
 seed is never returned by the API.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.doc:
Optional expiry time in UTC. When set, the key cannot authenticate requests
 after this time, regardless of status.

fields.name: created_by_actor
fields.doc:
Read-only actor label describing who created this key, such as a username
 or account label.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc:
Time in UTC when this key's configuration was last changed. For the same
 key, later is fresher, equal is an idempotent replay, and earlier is stale.
 Equal timestamps with different configuration indicate an invariant failure.
 This is independent of last_used_at, which tracks authentication activity.

fields.name: revision
fields.doc: Monotonic resource revision used for conditional updates.

fields.name: purpose
fields.doc:
What the key is for. ASSISTANT keys are managed with SetAssistantKeys and
 are otherwise listed, updated and revoked like any key. STRATEGY_BOT keys
 are managed only with SetStrategyBotAccess and EndStrategyBotAccess.

fields.name: strategy_bot_id
fields.doc:
Strategy bot the key trades for: the bot's public ID (opaque ID), the
 same bot_id strategies.v1 GetBot takes. Present only on a STRATEGY_BOT
 key.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

types.name: auth.v1.ApiKeyPurpose
types.doc: Purpose of an API key.

values.name: STANDARD
values.doc: A key the account holder created for their own programs.

values.name: ASSISTANT
values.doc:
A key the account holder created for the Polyester AI assistant through
 SetAssistantKeys. Its policy can never allow actions that move value out
 of the account or manage where it goes, such as external withdrawals or
 internal transfers. Only its creator's assistant uses it, so a sub-account
 assistant key is revoked when its creator loses the role that manages the
 sub-account's API keys or leaves the sub-account.

values.name: ADMIN_KEY
values.doc:
An elevated key the main account's owner created or promoted in a
 signed-in session with a fresh step-up proof. Its policy's admin
 permissions (MANAGE_API_KEYS, MANAGE_API_KEY_POLICIES and
 MANAGE_SUBACCOUNT_POLICIES) let it manage the main account's other keys
 and its owned sub-accounts' policies without a session. An admin key acts
 for the main account only, needs a non-empty IP allowlist of entries no
 broader than /24 (IPv4) or /48 (IPv6), and its policy can never allow an
 action that moves value out of the account or manages where it goes. No
 API key can create, promote, change or delete an admin key, including the
 key itself; only its owner's session with a fresh step-up proof can.

values.name: STRATEGY_BOT
values.doc:
A strategy bot's trade key, created with SetStrategyBotAccess on the
 bot's own sub-account and linked to the bot (strategy_bot_id). Its policy
 allows spot trading only, within the sub-account's trading limits, and
 never an action that moves value out of the account. No other call
 changes, revokes or re-binds it until EndStrategyBotAccess revokes it:
 FailedPrecondition with AUTH_STRATEGY_BOT_MANAGED. Disabling its
 sub-account disables it.

types.name: auth.v1.ApiKeyStatus
types.doc: Status of an API key.

values.name: ACTIVE
values.doc: Key can authenticate requests.

values.name: REVOKED
values.doc: Key has been permanently revoked and cannot be used again.

values.name: DISABLED
values.doc: Key is temporarily disabled and cannot authenticate requests until re-enabled.

types.name: auth.v1.ApiKeyUpdateSpec
types.doc: ApiKeyUpdateSpec contains mutable API key configuration.

cel.message: expires_at must be in the future or zero
cel.expression: !has(this.expires_at) ? true : this.expires_at == timestamp('1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') ? true : this.expires_at > now

fields.name: label
fields.doc:
Human-friendly label for the key. Empty clears the label when selected.
 Must not contain '<' or '>'.

fields.name: icon
fields.doc: User-chosen icon/emoji for UI display. Empty clears the icon when selected.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: User-chosen color token for UI display. Empty clears the color when selected.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: New status. ACTIVE and DISABLED are allowed; revocation uses DeleteApiKey.

fields.name: ip_whitelist
fields.doc: Complete replacement IP whitelist. Empty clears the restriction when selected.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.doc: Expiry time in UTC. When selected, omission or the epoch clears expiry.

fields.name: purpose
fields.doc:
New purpose: STANDARD demotes an admin key, ADMIN_KEY promotes a
 standard key. Only the main account's owner may select it, in a signed-in session
 with a fresh step-up proof. A promoted key must act for the main account,
 have an IP allowlist that admin keys accept, and have no policy that
 allows a money-out action. An assistant key's purpose never changes, and
 no key becomes or stops being a STRATEGY_BOT key.

types.name: auth.v1.ApiPolicySpec
types.doc: ApiPolicySpec contains the mutable configuration of an API key policy.

cel.message: spot_markets must be non-empty when spot_market_scope is ALLOWLIST
spot_markets must not contain duplicate symbol IDs

fields.name: name
fields.doc:
Human-readable policy name. Create requires a non-empty value; update
 validates it after merging fields selected by update_mask.

fields.name: description
fields.doc: Optional policy description for dashboards and audits. Maximum 256 characters.

fields.name: spot_markets
fields.doc: Allowed spot markets for this API key policy.

fields.name: spot_market_scope
fields.doc: Market-level scope for spot markets. When unspecified, defaults to ALL.

fields.name: actions
fields.doc:
High-level actions enabled for the API key policy. An empty list grants no
 access. Up to 64 unique explicit actions are allowed.

fields.name: is_template
fields.doc:
Whether the policy is a template, which SetApiKeyPolicy applies as a copy.
 Only the main account owner creates templates, and never together with
 assign_to_key_id. Chosen at creation: an update_mask that selects it is
 refused with InvalidArgument.

types.name: auth.v1.ApiPolicyView
types.doc:
ApiPolicyView is the public view of an API key policy template. Its action
 and spot-market floor cannot exceed an attached sub-account policy.

fields.name: id
fields.doc:
Policy identifier (opaque ID).

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Human-readable policy name.

fields.name: description
fields.doc: Optional policy description for dashboards and audits.

fields.name: spot_markets
fields.doc: Allowed spot markets for this API key policy.

fields.name: actions
fields.doc:
High-level actions enabled for this API key. Up to 64 unique explicit
 actions may be returned.

fields.name: spot_market_scope
fields.doc:
Market-level scope for spot markets. When ALL, spot_markets is returned
 for display only and is not enforced.

fields.name: is_template
fields.doc:
True if this policy is a template: a reusable policy of the main account
 that is never attached to an API key itself. Applying it with
 SetApiKeyPolicy attaches a copy, so editing the template later changes no
 API key. Set when the policy is created and never changes.

fields.name: source_template_id
fields.doc:
Template this policy was copied from (opaque ID), or 0 when it is not a
 copy. Set when the copy is made and never changes, even after the template
 is edited or deleted; the copy is not linked to the template.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: source_template_revision
fields.doc:
Revision of the template when this policy was copied from it, or 0 when
 it is not a copy. Compare it with the template's current revision to see
 whether the template changed since. Never changes.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: Creation time in UTC.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc: Last update time in UTC.

fields.name: revision
fields.doc: Monotonic resource revision used for conditional updates.

types.name: auth.v1.AppConnectionRequest
types.doc: A pending request from an app to connect to the account.

fields.name: client
fields.doc: The app that asks.

fields.name: scopes
fields.doc:
OAuth scopes the app asks for. "account:read" lets the app read the
 account as the signed-in website does: balances, orders, trades and
 account settings. "strategies:manage", which an app asks for only
 together with "account:read": Build, test and propose trading bots, and
 stop running bots. It can't deploy a bot or move funds. A connected app
 never moves money out of the account and never changes its security
 settings.

fields.name: resource
fields.doc: The server the app will use the account through, as an absolute URL.

fields.name: redirect_host
fields.doc: Host the app receives the answer on, from its registered redirect URL.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.doc: Time after which the request can no longer be approved or denied.

types.name: auth.v1.ApproveAppConnectionRequestRequest
types.doc: Request to approve a pending app connection request.

fields.name: request_id
fields.doc: Request ID the authorization endpoint gave the consent page.

types.name: auth.v1.ApproveAppConnectionRequestResponse
types.doc: The approved request's answer to the app.

fields.name: redirect_url
fields.doc:
URL to send the browser to: the app's redirect URL carrying a one-time
 authorization code. It is valid for 60 seconds.

types.name: auth.v1.AssistantKeyPreset
types.doc:
AssistantKeyPreset is a fixed permission set for a Polyester AI assistant
 key. SetAssistantKeys turns it into an API policy of the key's main account,
 named after the preset, so the policy and the key need only the set's one
 step-up proof. No preset ever allows a money-out action (EXTERNAL_WITHDRAW,
 INTERNAL_TRANSFER, MANAGE_ADDRESS_BOOK, MANAGE_AUTO_WITHDRAW), API-key or
 policy management, or any action that weakens account security.

values.name: READ_ONLY
values.doc:
Read actions only: READ_BALANCES, READ_SPOT, READ_INTERNAL_TRANSFERS,
 READ_AUTO_WITHDRAW, READ_API_KEYS, READ_SUBACCOUNTS,
 READ_DEPOSIT_ADDRESSES, READ_STATEMENTS and READ_FUNDING_FLOWS. On the
 main account, also the main-account permissions READ_PRICE_ALERTS,
 READ_VIP_STATUS, READ_REWARDS, READ_DAILY_CLAIMS, READ_CHECKPOINTS,
 READ_PROFILE, READ_SOCIAL_VERIFICATION and READ_NOTIFICATIONS. Policy
 name "Polyester AI - Read only (main account)" on the main account,
 "Polyester AI - Read only (sub-account)" on a sub-account.

values.name: TRADE_WITH_APPROVAL
values.doc:
READ_ONLY plus TRADE_SPOT, SWAP and CREATE_DEPOSIT_ADDRESS: the assistant
 also places, changes and cancels orders and triggers, and swaps, each only
 after the user approves that change, and creates deposit addresses, which
 move no funds out. On the main account, also MANAGE_PRICE_ALERTS: price
 alerts move no funds. Policy name "Polyester AI - Trade with
 approval (main account)" on the main account, "Polyester AI - Trade with
 approval (sub-account)" on a sub-account.

types.name: auth.v1.AssistantKeySpec
types.doc: AssistantKeySpec is one account's key in the caller's assistant key set.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Sub-account the key acts for (opaque ID). Unset means the caller's main
 account. A key acts for exactly one account.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: public_key_ed25519
fields.doc:
Ed25519 public key bytes the Polyester AI assistant signs with. Must be
 exactly 32 bytes, and distinct within the set.

fields.name: policy_id
fields.doc:
API policy that bounds the key (opaque ID). It must belong to the same
 main account as the key, must not be a template (FailedPrecondition with
 AUTH_POLICY_INVALID), and must not allow EXTERNAL_WITHDRAW,
 INTERNAL_TRANSFER, MANAGE_ADDRESS_BOOK or MANAGE_AUTO_WITHDRAW. Set
 exactly one of policy_id and preset.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: registration_deadline
fields.doc:
Time until which the key may be registered, as the Polyester AI assistant
 issued it with the key (PrepareAssistantKeys), in whole milliseconds.
 Required for a new key: it must still be ahead, and at most 15 minutes
 ahead. Not needed when the account's current assistant key already has
 this public key.

fields.name: registration_proof
fields.doc:
The key's own Ed25519 signature over the caller's account, the key's
 account, its public key and registration_deadline, as the assistant
 issued it with the key (64 bytes). Required for a new key; not needed
 when the account's current assistant key already has this public key.

fields.name: preset
fields.doc:
Permission preset that bounds the key, instead of policy_id. The key is
 bound to the preset's policy in the key's main account: the existing one
 with the preset's name and exactly its actions over all markets, else one
 created in the same change. The response's policy_id names it. Set
 exactly one of policy_id and preset.

types.name: auth.v1.AuthErrorCode
types.doc: High-level error codes for authentication and account-domain failures.

values.name: AUTH_USERNAME_INVALID
values.doc: Username format or characters are invalid.

values.name: AUTH_USERNAME_TAKEN
values.doc: Username is already used by another account.

values.name: AUTH_USERNAME_COOLDOWN
values.doc: Username was changed too recently.

values.name: AUTH_USERNAME_FEATURE_LOCKED
values.doc: Account is not currently eligible to claim or change a username.

values.name: AUTH_USERNAME_RESERVED
values.doc: Username is reserved and cannot be claimed by this account.

values.name: AUTH_INVALID_REQUEST
values.doc: Request is malformed or missing required input.

values.name: AUTH_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED
values.doc: Authentication is required for this operation.

values.name: AUTH_SESSION_KIND_NOT_ALLOWED
values.doc: Presented session type is not allowed for this operation.

values.name: AUTH_WALLET_LOGIN_FAILED
values.doc: Wallet login failed because the nonce or signature could not be verified.

values.name: AUTH_RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: Requested resource was not found.

values.name: AUTH_SUBACCOUNT_ACCESS_DENIED
values.doc: Caller does not have access to the requested sub-account.

values.name: AUTH_API_KEY_ACCESS_DENIED
values.doc:
Caller does not have access to the requested API key, or the calling API
 key's policy lacks the account permission the call needs, or the call needs
 a key scoped to the main account. Those two permission refusals name the
 permission in the message; an ownership refusal names none.

values.name: AUTH_API_KEY_INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION
values.doc: Requested API key status transition is not allowed.

values.name: AUTH_POLICY_INVALID
values.doc: Policy definition or binding is invalid.

values.name: AUTH_SMART_ACCOUNT_ALREADY_LINKED
values.doc: Smart-account address is already linked to another account.

values.name: AUTH_INVITE_ACCESS_DENIED
values.doc: Caller does not have access to the requested invite.

values.name: AUTH_INVITE_INVALID_STATE
values.doc: Invite cannot be used in its current state.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_DISABLED
values.doc: MFA is not available for this account.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_NOT_ENROLLED
values.doc: Required MFA factor is not enrolled.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_SESSION_INVALID
values.doc: MFA session is missing, expired, or invalid.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_CHALLENGE_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: MFA challenge was not found.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_CHALLENGE_INVALID
values.doc: MFA challenge payload is invalid.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_CHALLENGE_LOCKED
values.doc: MFA challenge is locked after too many failed attempts.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_OTP_INVALID
values.doc: One-time password is invalid.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_RECOVERY_INVALID
values.doc: Recovery code is invalid.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_PASSKEY_NOT_AVAILABLE
values.doc: Passkey verification is not available for this challenge.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_PASSKEY_CREDENTIAL_INVALID
values.doc: Passkey credential is invalid for this account or challenge.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_PASSKEY_VERIFY_FAILED
values.doc: Passkey verification failed.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_ENROLLMENT_BINDING_INVALID
values.doc: MFA enrollment binding is invalid or expired.

values.name: AUTH_STEP_UP_REQUIRED
values.doc: A fresh step-up proof is required for this protected operation.

values.name: AUTH_STEP_UP_PROOF_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: A requested step-up proof is unavailable.

values.name: AUTH_STEP_UP_ALREADY_CLAIMED
values.doc: The step-up proof has already been claimed.

values.name: AUTH_POLICY_IN_USE
values.doc: The requested policy cannot be removed because it is still in use.

values.name: AUTH_POLICY_LOCKED
values.doc: The requested policy is locked against this mutation.

values.name: AUTH_POLICY_SCOPE_MISMATCH
values.doc: The requested policy does not belong to the target account scope.

values.name: AUTH_REVISION_CONFLICT
values.doc: The resource changed after the caller read it.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_ELEVATION_REQUIRED
values.doc: A recently MFA-elevated interactive session is required.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_LAST_FACTOR_REQUIRED
values.doc: At least one active MFA factor must remain enrolled.

values.name: AUTH_INTERNAL_ERROR
values.doc: An unexpected server error stopped the request from completing.

values.name: AUTH_TERMS_NOT_ACCEPTED
values.doc: The caller has not accepted the terms required for this action.

values.name: AUTH_SOCIAL_VERIFICATION_EXPIRED
values.doc: Social verification challenge expired. Start a new verification, then mark it ready again.

values.name: AUTH_SOCIAL_VERIFICATION_INVALID_STATE
values.doc: Social verification cannot accept this request in its current state.

values.name: AUTH_SUBACCOUNT_CHALLENGE_INVALID
values.doc:
Sub-account authorization is expired, replaced, consumed, or has an invalid signature.
 Temporary verification failures return Unavailable; retry the same signed challenge.

values.name: AUTH_SOCIAL_ACCOUNT_ALREADY_LINKED
values.doc: Social account is already linked to another Polyester account.

values.name: AUTH_TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc:
The request could not be completed right now and changed nothing. Retry the same request.
 A refused WebSocket login needs a new signed login with a fresh nonce.

values.name: AUTH_SUBACCOUNT_OWNER_ROLE_LOCKED
values.doc:
The account owns this sub-account. An owner cannot be invited to it, and member role
 changes and member removal do not apply to the owner.

values.name: AUTH_SIGNATURE_INVALID
values.doc:
The API key request signature does not verify against the request, or the key is unknown.
 The REST problem code is SIGNATURE_INVALID.

values.name: AUTH_TIMESTAMP_SKEW
values.doc:
The API key request timestamp is malformed, more than 1 second ahead of the server
 clock, or older than the request's receive window (X-API-RECV-WINDOW, 5 seconds when
 omitted) when the request arrived. The request was not processed. The detail's
 timestamp_window carries the server time and the window the timestamp was checked
 against; the REST problem carries the same as its timestampWindow member. Sync the
 clock, for example with the server time from GET /v1/time or this refusal, then sign
 the request again with a fresh timestamp. The REST problem code is TIMESTAMP_SKEW.

values.name: AUTH_MISSING_HEADERS
values.doc:
The API key request lacks its timestamp or signature header, or a signed
 WebSocket login lacks a valid X-API-NONCE. The REST problem code is
 MISSING_HEADERS.

values.name: AUTH_KEY_EXPIRED
values.doc: The API key has expired. The REST problem code is KEY_EXPIRED.

values.name: AUTH_KEY_DISABLED
values.doc: The API key is disabled or revoked. The REST problem code is KEY_DISABLED.

values.name: AUTH_IP_NOT_ALLOWED
values.doc:
The API key's IP allowlist, an admin key's included, does not include the request's
 source address. ConnectRPC answers unauthenticated with this code in the
 AuthErrorDetail; the REST problem code is the short IP_NOT_ALLOWED, with HTTP 401.

values.name: AUTH_API_KEY_NOT_ACCEPTED
values.doc:
This API does not accept API keys; authenticate with a session token. The REST problem
 code is API_KEY_NOT_ACCEPTED.

values.name: AUTH_WALLET_ALREADY_LINKED
values.doc:
The wallet that signed this login is already linked to another account, so the
 submitted account address cannot be registered with it. Wallets are not moved between
 accounts. Log in with the account address this wallet already uses.

values.name: AUTH_RECV_WINDOW_INVALID
values.doc:
The API key request's X-API-RECV-WINDOW header is not a single whole number of
 milliseconds from 1 to 60000. The request was not processed. The REST problem code is
 RECV_WINDOW_INVALID.

values.name: AUTH_REPLAY_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED
values.doc:
Too many of this API key's signed requests are still within their receive windows,
 or too many of every key's, for another to be accepted. The request was not
 processed. Retry shortly; a shorter receive window lets requests make room sooner.
 ConnectRPC answers resource_exhausted. The REST problem code is
 REPLAY_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED, with HTTP 429.

values.name: AUTH_PATH_BODY_ID_MISMATCH
values.doc:
A non-empty request body identifier differs from the REST path identifier.
 The request is rejected with HTTP 400 before any action is performed.

values.name: AUTH_ASSISTANT_KEY_ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED
values.doc:
An assistant API key can never be allowed an action that moves value out of the
 account or manages where it goes: EXTERNAL_WITHDRAW, INTERNAL_TRANSFER,
 MANAGE_ADDRESS_BOOK or MANAGE_AUTO_WITHDRAW.

values.name: AUTH_ASSISTANT_KEY_PROOF_INVALID
values.doc:
A new assistant key's registration proof is missing or does not verify
 for its account, public key and registration deadline. The REST problem
 code is AUTH_ASSISTANT_KEY_PROOF_INVALID.

values.name: AUTH_ASSISTANT_KEY_REGISTRATION_EXPIRED
values.doc:
A new assistant key's registration deadline has passed; prepare the key
 again. The REST problem code is AUTH_ASSISTANT_KEY_REGISTRATION_EXPIRED.

values.name: AUTH_ASSISTANT_KEY_DEADLINE_TOO_FAR
values.doc:
A new assistant key's registration deadline is more than 15 minutes
 ahead. The REST problem code is AUTH_ASSISTANT_KEY_DEADLINE_TOO_FAR.

values.name: AUTH_REPLAY_DETECTED
values.doc:
The signed WebSocket login nonce has already been used. Create a new login
 with a fresh random nonce and signature. HTTP 401, REPLAY_DETECTED.

values.name: AUTH_SOCIAL_ACCOUNT_COOLDOWN
values.doc:
The X/Twitter or Discord account was unlinked from another Polyester
 account less than 30 days ago, and can be linked to a different account
 only after that. The account that unlinked it may link it again at once.
 retry_after says when. HTTP 412, AUTH_SOCIAL_ACCOUNT_COOLDOWN.

values.name: AUTH_SOCIAL_CHANGE_LIMIT_REACHED
values.doc:
The account already changed or unlinked its X/Twitter or Discord account
 less than 30 days ago: one change per provider every 30 days. retry_after
 says when the next one is allowed. HTTP 412, AUTH_SOCIAL_CHANGE_LIMIT_REACHED.

values.name: AUTH_ADMIN_KEY_REQUIRED
values.doc:
Only an admin API key may call this with an API key; the key that signed
 the request is not one. HTTP 403, AUTH_ADMIN_KEY_REQUIRED.

values.name: AUTH_ADMIN_KEY_ESCALATION_DENIED
values.doc:
The request would create, promote or change an admin key, or attach an
 admin permission, by API key. Only the main account's owner may, in a
 signed-in session with a fresh step-up proof. HTTP 403,
 AUTH_ADMIN_KEY_ESCALATION_DENIED.

values.name: AUTH_ADMIN_KEY_SCOPE_EXCEEDED
values.doc:
The admin API key's change would give a key more than the admin key's own
 scope allows: an IP allowlist entry outside the admin key's allowlist, or
 on a sub-account key more actions or markets than the sub-account's
 policy. HTTP 403, AUTH_ADMIN_KEY_SCOPE_EXCEEDED.

values.name: AUTH_ADMIN_KEY_FORBIDDEN_TARGET
values.doc:
An admin API key can never reach this target: an assistant key, a key or
 policy that allows a money-out action, a locked sub-account policy, or a
 sub-account the main account does not own. HTTP 403,
 AUTH_ADMIN_KEY_FORBIDDEN_TARGET.

values.name: AUTH_ADMIN_KEY_ALLOWLIST_INVALID
values.doc:
An admin key's IP allowlist is empty, or has an entry broader than /24
 (IPv4) or /48 (IPv6), or an IPv4-mapped IPv6 entry. HTTP 400,
 AUTH_ADMIN_KEY_ALLOWLIST_INVALID.

values.name: AUTH_ADMIN_KEY_ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED
values.doc:
An admin API key can never be allowed an action that moves value out of
 the account or manages where it goes: EXTERNAL_WITHDRAW,
 INTERNAL_TRANSFER, MANAGE_ADDRESS_BOOK or MANAGE_AUTO_WITHDRAW. HTTP 412,
 AUTH_ADMIN_KEY_ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED.

values.name: AUTH_CONNECTED_APP_LIMIT_REACHED
values.doc:
The account already has the most connected apps it may have. Disconnect
 an app before connecting another. FailedPrecondition.

values.name: AUTH_STRATEGY_BOT_MANAGED
values.doc:
A strategy bot manages this API key, policy or sub-account: until
 EndStrategyBotAccess ends the bot's access, no other call changes the
 bot's key or its policy, or the sub-account's policy, keys, members or
 invites, or enables the sub-account again. Disabling the sub-account,
 renaming it and removing its members stay available. HTTP 412,
 AUTH_STRATEGY_BOT_MANAGED.

values.name: AUTH_STRATEGY_BOT_SUBACCOUNT_INELIGIBLE
values.doc:
The sub-account cannot be given to a strategy bot: it is disabled,
 already a bot's or a QuickSwap broker vault, or has a policy, an API key
 that is not revoked, a member or a pending invite. HTTP 412,
 AUTH_STRATEGY_BOT_SUBACCOUNT_INELIGIBLE.

fields.doc: Smart Account EVM address for the new sub-account.

fields.name: message
fields.doc:
Exact EIP-191 authorization returned by CreateSubaccountChallenge. Maximum
 length is 4096 UTF-8 bytes.

fields.name: signature
fields.doc:
Smart-account signature over message using EIP-191 personal_sign semantics.
 Deployed ERC-1271 and counterfactual ERC-6492 signatures are supported.

fields.name: idempotency_key
fields.doc:
Optional caller-chosen key that makes this request safe to retry: 1 to
 128 letters, digits, '.', '_', ':' or '-'. It is unique within the root
 account and never reused, even after its sub-account is deleted. Every
 request is authenticated first, its signature included. Sending the
 identical request again (the same message, label, icon and color, for the
 same smart account address) under the same key returns the sub-account it
 created, with replayed set, and consumes no challenge; once that
 sub-account is deleted, it fails with NotFound and
 AUTH_RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND instead. Any other request under that key fails
 with AUTH_SUBACCOUNT_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Neither creates anything, so a
 resent or stale signed challenge never creates a second sub-account. After a lost response, a new challenge names the next smart
 account address, so a request carrying it conflicts when the first
 request did create the sub-account: find that sub-account in
 ListSubaccounts by its idempotency_key. Empty when none.

types.name: auth.v1.ListAccountActivityRequest
types.doc:
Request to list the activity of the caller's main account and its
 sub-accounts. Every filter narrows the result; an omitted filter matches
 every event the caller may read.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc:
Maximum number of events to return. Defaults to 50 when omitted; maximum is
 200.

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque keyset cursor from a previous response. The cursor is exclusive and
 bound to the authenticated main account, the API key when the caller is
 one, and every filter of the request: reuse it only with the same filters.

fields.name: subaccount_ids
fields.doc:
Sub-accounts (opaque IDs) whose events to return. Together with
 include_main_account it selects the accounts the list covers. When neither
 selects an account, the list covers the main account and every
 sub-account the caller may read. At most 100 distinct IDs. A sub-account
 the caller may not read fails the request with NotFound.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: include_main_account
fields.doc:
Include the main account's own events, those that belong to no
 sub-account. Set it alone to list only the main account's events, or with
 subaccount_ids to add the main account to those sub-accounts. An API key
 scoped to a sub-account may not set it.

fields.name: entity_kinds
fields.doc:
Entity categories to return. Empty matches every category. At most 16
 distinct values.

fields.name: event_actions
fields.doc: Actions to return. Empty matches every action. At most 32 distinct values.

fields.name: sources
fields.doc:
Client channels to return. Empty matches every channel. At most 8 distinct
 values.

fields.name: api_key_id
fields.doc:
API key whose actions to return, as ApiKey.key_id names it: only events
 performed with that key. Omit it to match every actor.

fields.name: start_time
fields.doc: Earliest event time to return, inclusive. Omit it for no lower bound.

fields.name: end_time
fields.doc:
Event time to return events before, exclusive. Omit it for no upper bound.
 When both bounds are set, end_time must be after start_time.

 for a key of the main account, SCOPE_SUBACCOUNT for a key bound to one
 sub-account. SCOPE_UNSPECIFIED when the request was not authenticated with
 an API key.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Sub-account the API key is bound to (opaque ID). Present only when
 api_key_scope is SCOPE_SUBACCOUNT. The key's private realtime channels
 and account reads name this sub-account, for example
 private:ledger:balances:<subaccount_id>.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: session
fields.doc: Session assurance details for the presented access token, if any.

fields.name: canonical_address
fields.doc: Destination address on the selected external network.

fields.name: raw_address_hex
fields.doc: Encoded destination payload as lowercase hex, when available.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc: Time this whitelist entry was last updated, as a UTC timestamp.

fields.name: polychain_chain_id
fields.doc: External network identifier for this whitelist entry.

types.name: auth.v1.PolicyAction
types.doc:
PolicyAction is a high-level permission that can be granted by a policy.
 Product actions apply to sub-account and API-key policies, and their
 write-style actions also grant the matching read visibility where needed by
 the product experience. Account permissions, each documented below as an
 account permission or a main-account permission, apply to API-key policies
 only: a sub-account policy refuses them. Each account permission grants
 exactly the calls it names and never implies another permission. A
 main-account permission is honored only for an API key scoped to the main
 account; a key scoped to a sub-account is refused even when its policy
 grants it. Admin permissions, documented below, apply to API-key policies
 only and are honored only for an admin API key. An API key without a policy
 has no permission at all.

values.name: TRADE_SPOT
values.doc:
Allow all spot order mutations: create, modify, replace, cancel, batch
 operations, live cancel-all, and arming or disabling cancel-all-after.
 Includes reading spot orders and trades and placing or modifying triggers.
 Authorized cancellation remains available when trading activity is disabled;
 this does not grant mutation access to a read-only API key.

values.name: INTERNAL_TRANSFER
values.doc:
Allow internal transfers between sub-accounts or linked Polyester accounts,
 including reading internal transfer history. Moves value out of the
 account, so an assistant API key can never be allowed it.

values.name: EXTERNAL_WITHDRAW
values.doc:
Allow value to leave Trading through external withdrawals. Destination
 authorization is enforced separately from this policy. Moves value out of
 the account, so an assistant API key can never be allowed it.

values.name: READ_BALANCES
values.doc: Allow reading balances and equity for a sub-account or API key.

values.name: READ_SPOT
values.doc:
Allow reading spot orders and trades, subscriptions, and cancel-all dry-run.
 Strictly non-mutating: cancellation and cancel-all-after changes require TRADE_SPOT.

values.name: READ_INTERNAL_TRANSFERS
values.doc: Allow reading internal transfer history.

values.name: READ_ADDRESS_BOOK
values.doc: Allow reading saved, recent, and whitelisted address-book destinations.

values.name: MANAGE_ADDRESS_BOOK
values.doc:
Allow creating, updating, deleting, and copying saved destination entries,
 including reading the address book. Address-book writes accept only a
 session token, so on an API-key policy this grants address-book reads only.
 It manages where value can leave the account, so an assistant API key can
 never be allowed it.

values.name: READ_AUTO_WITHDRAW
values.doc: Allow reading the auto-withdraw rule and its runs.

values.name: MANAGE_AUTO_WITHDRAW
values.doc:
Allow creating, changing, and disabling the auto-withdraw rule, including
 reading it. A rule pays value out, so changing one also requires
 EXTERNAL_WITHDRAW, API keys can never change one, and an assistant API key
 can never be allowed it.

values.name: SWAP
values.doc:
Allow quoting, creating, and reading Swaps: market conversions of the
 account's own Trading balance from one asset into another. Each Swap places
 spot orders on the account's behalf, which also remain subject to the
 sub-account's spot trading policy.

values.name: READ_API_KEYS
values.doc:
Allow listing and reading API keys. A key scoped to the main account sees
 the main account's keys and those of its sub-accounts; a key scoped to a
 sub-account sees only that sub-account's keys. Account permission.

values.name: READ_API_POLICIES
values.doc:
Allow listing and reading API-key policies. A key scoped to the main
 account sees every API-key policy of the main account; a key scoped to a
 sub-account sees only the policies attached to that sub-account's keys.
 Account permission.

values.name: READ_SUBACCOUNT_POLICIES
values.doc:
Allow listing and reading sub-account policies. A key scoped to the main
 account sees every sub-account policy of the main account; a key scoped to
 a sub-account sees only the policy attached to that sub-account. Account
 permission.

values.name: READ_SUBACCOUNT_PERMISSIONS
values.doc:
Allow reading what the key itself may do on a sub-account within its
 scope. Account permission.

values.name: READ_VIP_STATUS
values.doc: Allow reading the main account's VIP status. Main-account permission.

values.name: READ_SOCIAL_VERIFICATION
values.doc:
Allow reading the main account's social verification status: provider,
 handle, status, and verification time. Main-account permission.

values.name: READ_PROFILE
values.doc:
Allow reading the main account's profile and username history.
 Main-account permission.

values.name: READ_ACCOUNT_DIRECTORY
values.doc:
Allow resolving an account by username, account ID, or smart-account
 address. Any key of the main account may use it, whatever its scope.
 Account permission.

values.name: READ_WITHDRAW_VALIDATION
values.doc:
Allow validating an external withdraw destination within the key's scope
 without creating, signing, or reserving a withdraw. It does not allow
 withdrawing. Account permission.

values.name: READ_DAILY_CLAIMS
values.doc:
Allow reading the main account's daily reward claim status.
 Main-account permission.

values.name: CLAIM_DAILY_REWARD
values.doc:
Allow claiming the main account's daily reward, paid to the main account
 or a sub-account it owns. Main-account permission.

values.name: READ_CHECKPOINTS
values.doc: Allow reading the main account's checkpoints. Main-account permission.

values.name: READ_REWARDS
values.doc:
Allow reading the main account's published reward awards. Main-account
 permission.

values.name: CREATE_DEPOSIT_ADDRESS
values.doc:
Allow creating a deposit address within the key's scope. Account
 permission.

values.name: READ_DEPOSIT_ADDRESSES
values.doc:
Allow listing the deposit addresses within the key's scope. Account
 permission.

values.name: READ_SUBACCOUNTS
values.doc:
Allow listing and reading the subaccounts within the key's scope. Account
 permission.

values.name: READ_SUBACCOUNT_ACTIVITY
values.doc:
Allow reading the activity of the subaccounts within the key's scope.
 Account permission.

values.name: READ_SUBACCOUNT_MEMBERS
values.doc:
Allow listing the members of the subaccounts within the key's scope.
 Account permission.

values.name: READ_SUBACCOUNT_INVITES
values.doc:
Allow listing the outgoing invites of the subaccounts within the key's
 scope. Account permission.

values.name: READ_GUARD_SIGNER_STATUS
values.doc:
Allow reading the Guard Signer status within the key's scope; a key never
 reads another main account's Guard Signer. Account permission.

values.name: READ_PRICE_ALERTS
values.doc: Allow listing the main account's price alerts. Main-account permission.

values.name: MANAGE_PRICE_ALERTS
values.doc:
Allow creating, updating, and cancelling the main account's price alerts.
 It does not allow listing them. Main-account permission.

values.name: READ_STATEMENTS
values.doc:
Allow exporting account statements: the account's balance movements for a
 period, with fees and the balance after each entry. It grants no other
 balance or transfer read.

values.name: CONVERT_DUST
values.doc:
Allow quoting and converting dust, small Trading balances, into a target
 asset, and reading the conversions. Listing dust balances needs
 READ_BALANCES.

values.name: READ_FUNDING_FLOWS
values.doc:
Allow reading the account's deposit, withdrawal, and transfer flows,
 including the flows no chain transaction started and the transfers it
 receives from other accounts. It grants no balance or transfer read.

values.name: READ_NOTIFICATIONS
values.doc:
Allow listing, reading, and counting the main account's notifications.
 It does not allow marking them read or unread. Main-account permission.

values.name: READ_ACCOUNT_ACTIVITY
values.doc:
Allow listing the security and activity events of the main account and
 its sub-accounts within the key's scope: a key scoped to the main account
 reads all of them, a key scoped to a sub-account only that sub-account's.
 Account permission.

values.name: MANAGE_API_KEYS
values.doc:
Allow creating, updating and revoking the standard API keys of the main
 account and of the sub-accounts it owns. Admin permission: honored only
 for an admin API key, which never manages an admin or assistant key, a
 key whose policy allows a money-out action, or a sub-account shared with
 the main account. A key it creates or updates needs an IP allowlist
 within the admin key's own.

values.name: MANAGE_API_KEY_POLICIES
values.doc:
Allow attaching and clearing the API policies of the standard API keys
 the admin key may manage. A policy it attaches can never allow a
 money-out action or an admin permission, and on a sub-account key can
 never allow more actions or markets than the sub-account's policy. Admin
 permission: honored only for an admin API key.

values.name: MANAGE_SUBACCOUNT_POLICIES
values.doc:
Allow attaching, clearing and updating the policies of the sub-accounts
 the main account owns. The resulting policy can never allow a money-out
 action, and a locked policy is never changed. Admin permission: honored
 only for an admin API key.

values.name: READ_STRATEGIES
values.doc:
Allow reading the main account's bot strategies: their versions,
 backtests, review summaries, deploy proposals, bots and bot logs.
 Main-account permission.

values.name: DRAFT_STRATEGIES
values.doc:
Allow validating and storing bot strategy versions, running their
 behaviour examples, and starting backtests. It never deploys, changes,
 stops or deletes a bot, and grants no read beyond those calls' answers.
 Main-account permission.

values.name: PROPOSE_STRATEGY_DEPLOY
values.doc:
Allow recording a deploy proposal for a bot strategy version, which the
 user then deploys on the website with MFA and a wallet signature. It
 never deploys a bot, creates a subaccount or moves funds. Main-account
 permission.

values.name: READ_PNL
values.doc:
Allow reading the account's profit and loss: realized and unrealized PnL,
 holdings with their entry price, trading statistics and the daily
 series. It grants no balance or trade read. Like READ_BALANCES, it is
 part of every sub-account's read floor.

values.name: STOP_STRATEGIES
values.doc:
Allow stopping the main account's bots, keeping or cancelling their
 orders. Stopping only reduces what a bot does: it never deploys a bot,
 changes its money rules or moves funds. Main-account permission.

types.name: auth.v1.ProfileErrorCode
types.doc: High-level error codes for profile domain errors (ProfileService).

values.name: PROFILE_INVALID_FIELD
values.doc: Generic invalid field (format/characters).

values.name: PROFILE_FIELD_TOO_LONG
values.doc: Field exceeds configured max length.

values.name: PROFILE_URL_INVALID
values.doc: URL is syntactically invalid.

values.name: PROFILE_URL_SCHEME_INVALID
values.doc: URL scheme is not allowed (e.g., non-http(s)).

types.name: auth.v1.ProfileErrorDetail
types.doc: ProfileErrorDetail describes a profile validation failure returned by the API.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Stable machine-readable profile error code.

fields.name: field
fields.doc:
Field name associated with the error, such as "bio", "website", or
 "avatar_url".

fields.name: message
fields.doc: Human-friendly message for UI/debugging.

types.name: auth.v1.RegenerateRecoveryCodesRequest
types.doc: Request to rotate recovery codes.

types.name: auth.v1.RegenerateRecoveryCodesResponse
types.doc: Response containing newly generated recovery codes.

fields.name: recovery_codes
fields.doc: New one-time recovery codes. Store these securely; they are only returned in this response.

types.name: auth.v1.ReleaseFreshStepUpRequest
types.doc: Request to release a claimed fresh step-up proof when the protected request does not complete.

fields.name: step_up_id
fields.doc: Fresh step-up proof identifier returned by ClaimFreshStepUp.

fields.name: request_id
fields.doc: Client-generated request identifier used when the proof was claimed.

fields.name: action_type
fields.doc: Product action type used when the proof was claimed.

fields.name: subject
fields.doc: Product subject used when the proof was claimed.

fields.name: claim_nonce
fields.doc: One-time nonce returned by ClaimFreshStepUp.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc: Optional product-facing reason for releasing the claim. Maximum 128 characters.

types.name: auth.v1.ReleaseFreshStepUpResponse
types.doc: Empty response returned after a fresh step-up proof is released.

types.name: auth.v1.RemoveSubaccountMemberRequest
types.doc: Request to remove a delegated member from a sub-account.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Sub-account to modify (opaque ID).

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: grantee_account_id
fields.doc:
Root account ID of the member to revoke (opaque ID).

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

types.name: auth.v1.RemoveSubaccountMemberResponse
types.doc: Empty response returned after removing a sub-account member.

fields.name: smart_account_address
fields.doc: Smart account address of the internal transfer destination.

types.name: auth.v1.ResolveAccountRequest
types.doc:
ResolveAccountRequest searches for a transfer or sharing destination by
 username, account ID, or smart-account address.

fields.name: query
fields.doc:
Free-form query typed by the user. Can be:
 - a username, 3 to 64 characters using letters, digits, underscore, dot, or hyphen
 - an opaque root account or sub-account ID
 - an EVM smart-account address formatted as 0x plus 40 hex characters
 Maximum length is 128 characters.

fields.name: hint
fields.doc:
Optional hint for how to parse query. When unspecified, the service
 auto-detects by query shape.

fields.name: include_subaccounts
fields.doc:
When true, allow matches on sub-accounts as well as root accounts. Use
 this for internal transfer flows where the caller may want to resolve a
 specific sub-account by its ID or smart-account address. Username
 lookups remain root-only regardless of this flag.

types.name: auth.v1.ResolveAccountResponse
types.doc:
ResolveAccountResponse contains matching accounts. Username and root-only
 smart-account lookups return at most 5 matches; smart-account lookups with
 include_subaccounts may return at most 10 matches.

fields.name: matches
fields.doc: Matching destination accounts. Empty means no account matched the query.

types.name: auth.v1.ResolveHint
types.doc: ResolveHint controls how ResolveAccount interprets the query.

values.name: USERNAME
values.doc: Treat query as a username. Username lookups resolve root accounts only.

values.name: ID
values.doc: Treat query as an opaque root account or sub-account ID.

values.name: SMART_ACCOUNT
values.doc: Treat query as an EVM smart-account address.

types.name: auth.v1.ResolvedAccount
types.doc:
ResolvedAccount represents a lightweight view of a destination account for
 sharing or internal transfers.

fields.name: smart_account_address
fields.doc:
Smart-account address that would receive funds. This is the address that
 will receive the transfer, whether it belongs to a root account or a
 sub-account.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: Category of account that owns this address.

fields.name: root_username
fields.doc:
Root account username for the result. For sub-account results, this is the
 parent root account username. Empty means the root account has no username.

fields.name: subaccount_label
fields.doc: Optional sub-account label when kind is SUB.

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc:
Target account identifier (opaque ID). For root results this is an account
 ID; for sub-account results this is a sub-account ID.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

types.name: auth.v1.RespondSubaccountInviteRequest
types.doc: Request to accept, decline, or cancel an invitation.

fields.name: invite_id
fields.doc:
Invite identifier (opaque ID).

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: action
fields.doc: Action to apply to the invitation.

types.name: auth.v1.RespondSubaccountInviteResponse
types.doc: Response containing the updated invitation.

fields.name: invite
fields.doc: Invitation after applying the response action.

types.name: auth.v1.RevokeConnectedAppRequest
types.doc: Request to disconnect an app.

fields.name: connected_app_id
fields.doc:
Connected app ID from ListConnectedApps.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

types.name: auth.v1.RevokeConnectedAppResponse
types.doc: Empty response returned after the app is disconnected.

types.name: auth.v1.SessionInfo
types.doc: Current assurance details for an interactive session.

fields.name: session_id
fields.doc: Stable session identifier shared by the primary and MFA-elevated tokens.

fields.name: session_level
fields.doc: Assurance level represented by this session response.

fields.name: authentication_methods
fields.doc: Authentication methods used for this session state, such as wallet, TOTP, passkey, or recovery code. Maximum 8 unique values.

fields.name: auth_time
fields.doc: Time when the session was authenticated or elevated.

types.name: auth.v1.SessionLevel
types.doc: Session assurance level for the current interactive authentication context.

values.name: PRIMARY_AUTHENTICATED
values.doc: Primary login has completed, but MFA has not elevated this session.

values.name: MFA_ELEVATED
values.doc: MFA has elevated this session for ordinary protected account activity.

values.name: FRESH_STEP_UP
values.doc: A short-lived proof for one high-risk action.

types.name: auth.v1.SetApiKeyPolicyRequest
types.doc:
SetApiKeyPolicyRequest attaches a policy to an API key, applies a template to
 it, or clears its policy.

fields.name: key_id
fields.doc:
Opaque API key identifier, formatted as "ak_" followed by 32 lowercase hex
 characters.

fields.name: policy_id
fields.doc:
Policy to attach (opaque ID), owned by the key's main account. A template
 is applied: the key gets a new copy of its current revision, which later
 edits of the template do not change. A value of 0 clears the binding. An
 API key without an attached policy has no permissions.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

types.name: auth.v1.SetApiKeyPolicyResponse
types.doc: SetApiKeyPolicyResponse returns the policy now attached.

fields.name: policy_id
fields.doc:
Policy now attached to the key (opaque ID): the new copy when policy_id
 named a template, else policy_id. 0 when the policy was cleared.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

types.name: auth.v1.SetAssistantKeysRequest
types.doc: SetAssistantKeysRequest replaces the caller's assistant key set.

fields.name: keys
fields.doc:
The complete set, at most one key per account and at most 64 keys. An
 account left out loses its assistant key.

types.name: auth.v1.SetAssistantKeysResponse
types.doc: SetAssistantKeysResponse returns the caller's assistant key set.

fields.name: api_keys
fields.doc: The assistant keys now in the set, in request order.

types.name: auth.v1.SetStrategyBotAccessRequest
types.doc:
SetStrategyBotAccessRequest gives a strategy bot its trade key on its own
 sub-account.

fields.name: deploy_operation_id
fields.doc:
Identifier of the deploy operation, chosen by the caller and unique
 within the main account: 1 to 128 characters of letters, digits, '.',
 '_', ':' and '-'. Repeating a request under it changes nothing.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Sub-account the bot trades on (opaque ID).

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: public_key_ed25519
fields.doc:
Ed25519 public key bytes of the bot's trade key. Must be exactly 32
 bytes. The private key or seed must never be sent to the API.

fields.name: strategy_bot_id
fields.doc:
Strategy bot the key trades for: the bot's public ID (opaque ID), the
 same bot_id strategies.v1 GetBot takes.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: limits
fields.doc: Trading limits of the sub-account.

types.name: auth.v1.SetStrategyBotAccessResponse
types.doc:
SetStrategyBotAccessResponse names the bot's key and the policies that
 bound it.

fields.name: key_id
fields.doc:
The bot's STRATEGY_BOT key, formatted as "ak_" followed by 32 lowercase
 hex characters.

fields.name: api_policy_id
fields.doc:
API policy bound to the key (opaque ID).

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: subaccount_policy_id
fields.doc:
Sub-account policy bound to the bot's sub-account (opaque ID).

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

types.name: auth.v1.SetSubaccountMemberMFARequirementRequest
types.doc: Request to update the delegated-member MFA requirement for a sub-account.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Sub-account whose delegated-member MFA requirement should be updated (opaque ID).

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: require_member_mfa
fields.doc:
When true, delegated interactive members must satisfy MFA requirements for
 protected sub-account actions. This does not apply to read-only real-time
 subscriptions.

types.name: auth.v1.SetSubaccountMemberMFARequirementResponse
types.doc: Empty response returned after updating the delegated-member MFA requirement.

types.name: auth.v1.SetSubaccountPolicyRequest
types.doc:
SetSubaccountPolicyRequest attaches a policy to a sub-account, applies a
 template to it, or clears its policy.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Sub-account identifier (opaque ID).

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: policy_id
fields.doc:
Policy to attach (opaque ID), owned by the sub-account's main account. A
 template is applied: the sub-account gets a new copy of its current
 revision, which later edits of the template do not change. A value of 0
 clears the explicit binding and restores the system Read Only policy.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

types.name: auth.v1.SetSubaccountPolicyResponse
types.doc: SetSubaccountPolicyResponse returns the policy now attached.

fields.name: policy_id
fields.doc:
Policy now attached to the sub-account (opaque ID): the new copy when
 policy_id named a template, else policy_id. 0 when the policy was cleared.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

types.name: auth.v1.SocialProvider
types.doc: Social account provider used for account ownership verification.

values.name: TWITTER
values.doc: X/Twitter account verification.

values.name: DISCORD
values.doc: Discord account verification.

values.name: TELEGRAM
values.doc:
Telegram account linking. The user sends the challenge code to the Polyester
 Telegram bot, then confirms the Telegram account that sent it.

types.name: auth.v1.SocialVerification
types.doc:
SocialVerification describes the caller's current verification state for one
 social provider.

fields.name: id
fields.doc:
Verification identifier.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as int64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: provider
fields.doc: Provider account being verified.

fields.name: method
fields.doc:
Method used for this verification. If unspecified at start time, the
 provider default is used.

fields.name: handle
fields.doc:
Provider handle being verified. Handles are returned lowercase and without
 a leading "@". For Telegram, the username of the account that submitted the
 code; empty when that account has no username.

fields.name: provider_user_id
fields.doc:
Stable provider-side user identifier of the linked provider account. Empty
 while no account is linked. A restarted X/Twitter or Discord verification
 keeps the current link, and this value, until the new verification succeeds
 and replaces it. For Telegram, while the status is
 STATUS_AWAITING_CONFIRMATION, it is the numeric user ID of the Telegram
 account that submitted the code, the value ConfirmSocialVerification takes.

fields.name: display_name
fields.doc:
Provider display name of the account being verified, for showing it to the
 user. Telegram only: the account's name, set once the code is submitted.
 Empty for other providers.

fields.name: challenge_code
fields.doc:
Challenge code the user must submit according to the verification method.
 Discord and Telegram codes are returned only when a challenge is issued.
 Codes expire after 15 minutes.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Current verification status.

fields.name: requested_at
fields.doc: Time in UTC when the current challenge code was issued.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.doc: Time in UTC when the current challenge code expires.

fields.name: verified_at
fields.doc:
Time in UTC when the linked provider account was last verified. Empty while
 no account is linked; kept, like provider_user_id, while a restarted
 verification runs.

fields.name: attempts
fields.doc: Number of recorded provider-check attempts for this challenge.

fields.name: last_error
fields.doc:
Last verification error, if the most recent check failed. Empty when there
 is no recorded error.

fields.name: error_code
fields.doc:
Stable machine-readable error code for the current failed verification.
 Unspecified when no typed error applies. REST JSON writes the value
 without the AUTH_ prefix, for example SOCIAL_ACCOUNT_COOLDOWN; ConnectRPC
 writes its full name, AUTH_SOCIAL_ACCOUNT_COOLDOWN.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc: Time in UTC when this verification state last changed.

fields.name: retry_after
fields.doc:
Time in UTC from which a new verification may succeed, when this one
 failed with error_code SOCIAL_ACCOUNT_COOLDOWN or
 SOCIAL_CHANGE_LIMIT_REACHED (in ConnectRPC, AUTH_SOCIAL_ACCOUNT_COOLDOWN
 or AUTH_SOCIAL_CHANGE_LIMIT_REACHED). Empty otherwise.

fields.name: change_available_at
fields.doc:
Time in UTC from which the caller may change or unlink its X/Twitter or
 Discord account again. Each provider allows one change or unlink per 30
 days; until this time, changing or unlinking the linked account fails with
 AUTH_SOCIAL_CHANGE_LIMIT_REACHED and a retry_after equal to it. Set
 whenever the limit applies, whether or not a verification failed. Empty
 when a change or unlink is allowed now, and always for Telegram. A first
 link, a link after an unlink, and a re-verification of the linked
 X/Twitter handle are not changes and are allowed while it is set.

types.name: auth.v1.SocialVerificationMethod
types.doc: How the user proves control of the provider account.

values.name: METHOD_PROFILE
values.doc: User places the challenge code in their public provider profile.

values.name: METHOD_CHANNEL
values.doc: User posts the challenge code in a provider channel.

values.name: METHOD_DM
values.doc: User sends the challenge code in a direct message.

types.name: auth.v1.SocialVerificationReadyRequest
types.doc:
SocialVerificationReadyRequest tells the API that the challenge code has been
 placed and the provider account is ready to check.

fields.name: provider
fields.doc: Provider account to check.

types.name: auth.v1.SocialVerificationReadyResponse
types.doc:
SocialVerificationReadyResponse returns the verification after it has been
 queued for a provider check.

fields.name: verification
fields.doc: Current verification state after the provider check was requested.

types.name: auth.v1.SocialVerificationStatus
types.doc: Current state of a social account verification attempt.

values.name: STATUS_PENDING_USER_ACTION
values.doc: Code issued; waiting for the user to complete the provider-specific action.

values.name: STATUS_QUEUED
values.doc: User marked the code as placed and the verification check is waiting to run.

values.name: STATUS_IN_PROGRESS

fields.doc:
Owner-controlled security baseline for delegated interactive members on

fields.doc:
Smart-account derivation salt nonce assigned when this sub-account was
 created. Present only when the caller owns the sub-account and can use it

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc:
Time in UTC when this sub-account's configuration was last changed. For the
 same sub-account, later is fresher, equal is an idempotent replay, and
 earlier is stale. Equal timestamps with different configuration, other
 than role and removed, indicate an invariant failure.

fields.name: revision
fields.doc: Monotonic resource revision used for conditional updates.

fields.name: removed
fields.doc:
True when the caller no longer has access to this sub-account, for
 example after its owner removed the caller as a member: remove the
 sub-account from the caller's list. Only real-time updates set it;
 responses list only sub-accounts the caller can access. A change of the
 caller's role or access does not change revision or updated_at, so
 real-time updates deliver such changes in order and each one applies as
 it arrives. Ending access also ends the caller's subscriptions to this
 sub-account's real-time channels, and can, rarely, also end a
 subscription made after access was granted again. When the server ends a
 subscription to one of this sub-account's channels while the latest
 update lists this sub-account with a role and removed false, subscribe
 again: access is checked again on subscribe.

fields.doc:
The idempotency_key of the request that created this sub-account, so a
 caller that lost CreateSubaccount's response can find it. Present only

 kind of caller that can create one; real-time updates omit it. Empty when
 none was given.

types.name: auth.v1.UserProfile
types.doc: UserProfile is the caller's public profile and account metadata.

fields.name: username
fields.doc:
Public username for the root account. Usernames are unique
 case-insensitively and use 3 to 32 letters, digits, underscores, dots, or
 hyphens. Empty means no username is set.

fields.name: bio
fields.doc: Short public bio. Maximum length is 256 characters.

fields.name: website
fields.doc: Public website URL, if set. Maximum length is 256 characters.

fields.name: twitter
fields.doc:
Handle of the account's verified X/Twitter account, without "@", as X
 reports it at the latest successful verification. Empty while no X account
 is linked. Only SocialVerificationService sets it; UpdateProfile cannot.
 Maximum length is 15 characters.

fields.name: twitter_verified
fields.doc: Whether an X/Twitter account is linked: true exactly when twitter is set.

fields.name: discord
fields.doc: Discord handle or username without "@". Maximum length is 64 characters.

fields.name: discord_verified
fields.doc: Whether the Discord handle for this account has been verified.

fields.name: avatar_url
fields.doc: Avatar URL, if set. Maximum length is 256 characters.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc:
Account creation time in UTC. This is the canonical "member since"
 timestamp.

fields.name: next_username_change_at
fields.doc:
Next time in UTC when the username can be changed again. Omitted when no
 cooldown applies.

fields.name: vip_tier
fields.doc:
Current VIP tier for this root account. A value of 0 is the base tier.
 Read-only.

fields.name: username_unlocked
fields.doc: Whether this account is currently allowed to claim/change a username.

fields.name: current_terms_accepted
fields.doc:
Whether the caller's root account accepted the terms required for restricted actions.
 False when the required terms have not been accepted.

types.name: auth.v1.UserProfilePatch
types.doc:
UserProfilePatch is a partial profile update. Fields are
 optional/presence-aware:
 - if a field is omitted, it is not modified
 - if a field is present with an empty string, it is cleared
 Username changes are subject to account eligibility, reserved-name checks,
 uniqueness, and cooldown rules. Case-only username changes update display
 casing without consuming the cooldown.

fields.name: username
fields.doc:
Public username for the root account. Use an empty string to clear it.
 Non-empty values must be 3 to 32 letters, digits, underscores, dots, or
 hyphens.

cel.message: username must be empty or 3-32 chars of letters, digits, underscore, dot, hyphen

fields.name: bio
fields.doc:
Short public bio. Use an empty string to clear it. Non-empty values must be
 at most 256 characters and cannot contain "<" or ">".

cel.message: bio must be empty or <= 256 characters and must not contain '<' or '>'

fields.name: website
fields.doc:
Public website URL. Use an empty string to clear it. Non-empty values must
 be valid http(s) URLs up to 256 characters.

cel.message: website must be empty or a valid http(s) URL

fields.name: avatar_url
fields.doc:
Avatar URL. Use an empty string to clear it. Non-empty values must be valid
 http(s) URLs up to 256 characters.

cel.message: avatar_url must be empty or a valid http(s) URL
